Do you know why South Koreans excel at fabricating history? Koreans' nationalism and your humble history are the most contradictory things! You always like to emphasize your independent culture when you're subservient to other major powers. When Goryeo submitted to the Mongols, it treated Mongols as a "father-in-law" . During the Ming Dynasty, it likewise designated the Ming Empire as its "father state." It seems that being a vassal to a great power—and receiving its protection—is a source of great pride for you. Is that how you reduce your inferiority complex? According to strict historical records, Korea has never been a truly independent country. When it was subjugated by the Mongols, at the same time, Goryeo offered women as tribute to the Mongols and enjoyed their protection. You constantly claim to have an independent culture, even  the Korean script is based on the Mongol Yuan dynasty's Phags-pa script. During the Ming and Qing dynasties, it was again subjugated by China, imitating the Ming dynasty's political and bureaucratic systems, as well as the clothing of officials and nobles. High-quality fabrics were all imported from China, and ordinary Koreans could only wear white. During the Ming dynasty, the Imjin War nearly destroyed the country! After the Ming dynasty helped you restore your nation, you then claimed to be the main force in resisting the Imjin War. It's ridiculous. The Korean Peninsula only entered the industrial age after being colonized by Japan, and women only then began to cover their breasts. Even today, the North and South are divided, each needing the protection of its own powerful backer. How damn glorious! 
Even if Korea was once a tributary state of China, that doesn't mean it can steal Chinese culture at will. Even if it was colonized by Japan for half a century, that doesn't mean it can steal Japanese culture at will. Historically, Korea has always been a country that enjoys being a vassal state. You always claim to have an independent culture, but what's the result? Over 60% of your vocabulary comes from Chinese, and 20% from English; you can't speak without an external language. Look at your flag; even if you don't want to admit it, your national flag, the Taegeukgi, was designed by Ma Jianzhong 马建忠of the Qing Dynasty. What? Can't accept it? Are you going to start fabricating history again? 
No wonder you people ended up writing something like the *Hwandan Gogi*환단고기—it’s clearly a case of deep-seated inferiority!
